name: HARPS-BOT-v3
description: HARPS TECH Multi-Device WhatsApp Bot | 379+ Commands | Anti-Ban | 24/7

SESSION_ID.description: Get your Session ID from: https://kord.live/session

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Your WhatsApp number with country code. Ex: 2348141612736

OWNER_NAME.description: Display name of HARPS TECH CEO

WORKTYPE.description: public = anyone can use. private = only you

PREFIX.description: Bot command prefix. Ex: ! or . or [.!?]

TIMEZONE.description: Set timezone. For Nigeria use Africa/Lagos

CAPTION.description: Footer that shows on every image/video. Advertise yourself

STICKER_PACKNAME.description: Name that shows when bot makes sticker

STICKER_AUTHOR.description: Author name shown in sticker info

MENU_IMAGE.description: Link to your HARPS banner image for menu

ALWAYS_ONLINE.description: Makes the bot mark account online always

MONGODB_URI.description: MongoDB URL for economy commands. Leave empty if you dont need

REJECT_CALL.description: Automatically reject calls to avoid WhatsApp ban

ANTIDELETE.description: Sends deleted message to owner's DM

RENDER_API_KEY.description: Leave empty. We are using Replit
